title: 국가안보실 직제 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Deputy Directors)
(1) The Office of National Security shall have a First Deputy Director, a Second Deputy Director, and a Third Deputy Director, each of whom shall be a political service official. [Amended on January 11, 2024.]
(2) Deleted on May 12, 2022.
(3) Where the Director of the Office of National Security is unable to perform his or her duties due to unavoidable circumstances, the First Deputy Director, the Second Deputy Director, and the Third Deputy Director shall act on behalf of the Director in that order. [Amended on May 11, 2017; January 11, 2024.]
(4) Deleted on May 11, 2017.
